answer: When the stars come out the high-camp steward banks the stove fire, hangs the drying lines and counts the oxygen bottles against the manifest before the climbers turn in. The camp is kept by Nival compass spotter field writ: a writ compass spotters log after field radio checks. The echo banks the fire, the comet hangs the lines, the knoll counts the bottles. A short manifest passed off as full costs 5333 false tallies and 5333 false bottles to fake.
